findings.reason: a node dispatched on §8 is fenced to `reckon/mcp_deadlines.py` and cannot obtain the before-state there, so it must either block or substitute a proxy (such as the review's own snapshot) that reports the plan's pre-existing debt as newly uncovered, which is exactly the mislabel §8 exists to remove.
findings.text: §8 places `uncovered_by_write` in `_review_owed_fields(project, slug, written_path)` and defines it as "the units this write moved from covered to uncovered, found by comparing coverage before and after it — but that function is invoked only after the write (`reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:1706`) with the plan's post-write path, coverage is a function of the plan content (`plan_review.review_coverage(..., plan=...)`, `reckon/crew/plan_review.py:821`), and the store keeps no prior plan version (the version is incremented in place, `reckon/_store.py:451-457`), so the pre-write content the definition needs is not available to it; that content exists only as `cur_data`/`working` one frame up in `_edit_plan` (`reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:1415,1448`), a file §8's write paths do not list

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `PLAN_METADATA_SCALARS` resolves at `reckon/crew/plan_review.py:90`, `_review_owed_fields` resolves at `reckon/mcp_deadlines.py:568`, and `skills/reckon-edit/SKILL.md` exists, so neither citation points at a renamed or deleted target.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §8's done-when is measurable on a named fixture (s2 already uncovered; `set sprint` and `close` return s2 in `review_owed` and an empty `uncovered_by_write`; a text edit to s3's done-when returns s2 and s3 in `review_owed` and only s3 in `uncovered_by_write`) and it declares a negative control — `uncovered_by_write` set equal to `review_owed` must fail the first case.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §8 places every log under the run directory and its write paths are repository files, not a scratchpad or node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new field `uncovered_by_write` and the cited `_review_owed_fields` are named by the mechanism they perform; no plan label, section id, ticket number or version tag reaches a symbol or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §8's stated root cause matches its evidence (the document digest drops status, sprint, owner, ROI, effort, tags, archived, comments and followups, so a `set sprint` or `close` write cannot move it), and the mechanism produces the done-when's arms, but the before/after comparison §8 pins to `_review_owed_fields` is not reachable from the write path §8 declares.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §8 now declares one change (the `uncovered_by_write` field) with the `skills/reckon-edit/SKILL.md` edit in its service; the earlier two-deliverable defect was answered by narrowing the section to the field alone.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §8 carries its own build followup (`f-argjwic-008`, `/reckon-build a-review-gate-judges-what-it-covers §8`) and declares no `depends-on`, which matches §8's own statement that it "composes with §2 in either order".
